name: Pick it right here
changes: Open the date picker beside the booking button, with no long jump down the page.
Use one month menu with both years listed, starting with the next bookable month.
Show the full trip dates and price beside each booking button.
On a phone, open the same choices in a bottom sheet.
body: Customers choose a date where they already want to book. This drawing shows October 2027 so the price change is visible. The compact menu saves space, but it makes comparing months harder.
risk: The sheet needs careful focus handling, a visible close button, and a clean handoff to the booking pop-up.
